findings.title: Exposed Anthropic API Key in .env file
findings.description: An active Anthropic API key is present in llm-mesh/.env file. While .env is gitignored, this represents a credential that should be rotated if exposed.
findings.remediation: Rotate the API key immediately at console.anthropic.com and ensure .env files are never committed

findings.title: Critically Outdated @anthropic-ai/sdk
findings.description: Package @anthropic-ai/sdk is at version 0.32.1, but latest is 0.70.1. This represents a significant version gap that may include security fixes.

findings.title: Major Version Gap in OpenAI SDK
findings.description: Package openai is significantly outdated (4.104.0 vs 6.9.1). Major version changes often include critical security improvements.
findings.remediation: Update to openai@6.9.1 with careful review of breaking changes

findings.title: Multiple spawn/exec calls without input sanitization review
findings.description: Found 24 files with spawn/exec/child_process patterns. While many appear to be legitimate system operations, command injection risks should be reviewed.
findings.remediation: Audit all spawn/exec calls to ensure user input is properly sanitized before use in commands

findings.title: Placeholder API Keys in Documentation
findings.description: README documentation contains placeholder API key patterns (sk-ant-..., sk-...) that could confuse users about proper key handling.
findings.remediation: Replace with clearly marked placeholder text like YOUR_API_KEY_HERE

findings.title: Development Mode API Authentication Bypass
findings.description: Dashboard configuration allows authentication bypass in development mode when API_KEY is not set, which could be a security risk if accidentally deployed.
findings.remediation: Add startup warnings and consider requiring API_KEY even in development

findings.title: Jest and Types Outdated (Major Version)
findings.description: Jest 29.7.0 vs 30.2.0 and @types/jest 29.5.14 vs 30.0.0 represent major version gaps in testing dependencies.
findings.remediation: Update to Jest 30.x with breaking change review

findings.title: innerHTML usage in bundled assets
findings.description: Found innerHTML usage in bundled dashboard assets. While likely from EUI library, XSS risks should be monitored.
findings.remediation: Ensure all dynamic content is properly sanitized before rendering

findings.title: Missing minisearch Installation
findings.description: Package minisearch is listed as wanted but not currently installed.
findings.remediation: Run npm install to ensure all dependencies are properly installed
